3. **Planks**: While primarily an upper body exercise, planks also engage the core muscles, which support the stability and strength of the lower body. Performing planks effectively can indirectly benefit leg strength by enhancing overall core stability.

4. **Balance Exercises (Single-Leg Stands)**: These exercises are crucial for proprioception and balance, as well as directly working on the stabilizer muscles of the legs. Improving balance can help reduce the risk of injuries and improve agility on the field.
